description: The exact live PCS view route returned by the official Google IMA live sample producer. Opaque xai, sai and sig receive template-completeness warnings. Signatures and unpublished PCS variants are outside this profile.

params.name: xai
params.description: Nonempty opaque signed field in the official IMA sample response. Only template completeness is observable.

params.name: sai
params.description: Nonempty opaque signed field in the official IMA sample response. Only template completeness is observable.

params.name: sig
params.description: Nonempty opaque signed field in the official IMA sample response. Only template completeness is observable.

params.name: adurl
params.description: Optional source-generated callback field. Empty adurl is explicitly emitted by the official view template.

params.description: Optional source-generated callback field. Empty adurl is explicitly emitted by the official view template.
